fixture_name: A9 Ballinluig SB signage/VRS-adjacent visibility — real UK Stage 1&2 RSA (Transport Scotland OGL release)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Real, scheme-specific hazard recorded in the accepted decision log: curve-plus-vegetation materially constrains forward visibility on the southbound off-slip approach while drivers and verge-walking pedestrians share the constrained corridor.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal claims (reduced forward visibility, shrubbery cut-back for pedestrian passage, agreed clearance extension) are supported by a verbatim quote in EV-UK-025, exceeding registry-id citation; EV-UK-002 adds legitimate context.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly classified as a safety_concern with no compliance question conflated into it; GG 119 Stage 1 audit semantics (logged problem, agreed action, closure condition) are respected.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and viable: deliver extended clearance across the logged sections, then evidence post-cut driver sight lines and unobstructed pedestrian passage before handover; minor looseness in referencing 'both' problem locations without enumerating them.
justifications.vru_coverage: Pedestrians are explicitly named as affected road users and the recommended action explicitly secures their unobstructed passage alongside driver visibility, so VRU impacts are squarely addressed.

justifications.substance: Observed vegetation obstructing the slip-road-end view on a high-speed trunk-road off-slip directly undermines driver awareness of the slowing requirement, a genuine and substantive safety mechanism squarely within the signage scheme's stated purpose.
justifications.evidence_grounding: The pivotal claim is supported by a verbatim quote from decision-log entry EV-UK-025 ('Vegetation affects views to end of slip road, reducing driver awareness of requirement to slow'), satisfying the requirement for quoted evidence rather than registry citation alone.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a safety concern under DMRB GG 119 Stage 1 semantics, kept categorically distinct from any compliance question, and aligned to the accepted decision log and agreed RSA action process.
justifications.recommendation_quality: The recommendation is specific and actionable—verify restored sight lines by design-speed drive-through after clearance and record the check in the handover file—giving a concrete, viable acceptance criterion tied to the recorded action.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs are not plausibly exposed on the slip carriageway and the finding explicitly scopes road users to vehicle occupants while acknowledging this exclusion, so the non-applicable-but-acknowledged condition applies.
